# Performance Checklist: AVD Emulator Setup

**Purpose**: Validate performance requirements quality for emulator setup
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and verified as meeting the requirements-quality standard.

## Performance Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 - Are performance goals (emulator responsiveness, boot time) quantified or bounded? [Measurability, Spec §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK002 - Is hardware acceleration (KVM) specified as a requirement with performance implications? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK003 - Are ABI selection criteria justified with performance considerations? [Clarity, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 - Are graphics rendering options (swiftshader_indirect vs hardware) documented with trade-offs? [Completeness, Clarifications]

## Benchmarking & Latency

- [x] CHK005 - Are SC-009 latency measurement requirements with emulator caveats explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the distinction between emulator measurements and reference device measurements documented? [Clarity, Research §Decisions]
- [x] CHK007 - Are measurement conditions (cold boot, ABI, graphics mode) required to be documented? [Completeness, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 - Are emulator results classified as regression indicators vs definitive pass/fail? [Clarity, Research §Decisions]

## Optimization & Tuning

- [x] CHK009 - Are emulator launch flags (no-boot-anim, no-audio, gpu settings) specified for different use cases? [Completeness, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK010 - Are build target selection criteria (x86_64 vs aarch64) defined based on use case? [Clarity, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK011 - Are animation disabling requirements specified for consistent measurements? [Completeness, Research]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are resource allocation considerations (RAM/CPU) addressed? [Gap]

## Notes

- Items focus on performance requirements quality, not implementation benchmarks.
